links.outcome: Expert-rated accuracy, completeness, and safety of ChatGPT answers to pregnancy questions
links.effect: Accuracy mean 4.2 (80% positive); completeness mean 3.8 (46.7% positive); safety mean 3.9 (53.3% positive); no response averaged below 3.
links.quote: The responses scored less for the completeness criterion, with a mean rating of 3.8 and 46.7% of questions received a positive rating.

screen.reason: Expert evaluation of standard ChatGPT responses to common obstetric questions for accuracy, completeness, and safety without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
